Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the THEMIS-Strep interactome in resting versus anti-CD3 stimulated Jurkat cells. While the paper describes extensive genetic perturbations (shRNA knock-downs and KI mutations), these were validated via flow cytometry and immunoblotting; the MS data acquisition is explicitly tied to the resting vs. activated state of cells expressing THEMIS-Strep.
